result.reason: The operative revision reaches the preferred position: renewals are limited to successive 12-month periods, require mutual written agreement, and cap fee increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. No reminder is required because renewal is not automatic. The edit is confined to the unilateral seven-year renewal right and pricing, while leaving unrelated termination rights intact. Drafting is generally professional, though the retained Sections II and III are redundant and Section II contains the incomplete phrase “mutual written of the parties,” which should read “mutual written agreement of the parties.”
